commits.description: Commits replayed onto the server's history.

grafted.description: The commit on the server's history the branch became.

previous.description: Where the server's branch was before.

reason.description: What kind of refusal it was: `invalid_name`, `target_branch`, `case_conflict`, `invalid_tip`, `not_pushed`, `not_on_snapshot`, `conflict`, `merge_conflict` or `diverged`.

rule.description: For an `updated` branch, what allowed it.

status.description: `created`, `updated`, `unchanged` or `refused`; `unchanged` when the server's branch was at the graft already, or ahead of it.

CheckinRuleJson.description: Why the server let a check-in move a branch it already had.

oneOf.description: The server's branch is in the new commit's history.
This checkout set the branch last, so it replaces its own work.
A rebase that keeps every commit the server's branch had, by change id.

branches.description: One entry per branch; empty when no branch had commits to check in.

gave_change_ids.description: Commits made with plain Git that were given a change id first (their branches were rewritten with it).

refused.description: Whether any branch was refused (the exit status is then `1`).
